scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: State Capital Investment Subsidy
other_conditions: Applicable to tourism projects/units set up on or after 22 February 2021
Applicable to expansion projects of existing units set up on or after 22 February 2021
Eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 and could not apply earlier due to absence of a Bar in the hotel
Units may belong to private, co‑operative, joint sector or be owned/managed by the State Government
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report prepared for the purpose
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation
Eligibility category noted in source: micro
Eligibility category noted in source: small
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy ranging from 7.5% to 25% of eligible investment, with caps between ₹1 crore and ₹1.75 crore and a building‑component limit of 50% of the total subsidy.
